reports.title: 2026-11-18 Desktop Angebot Search — SYSTEMTREFF Ed76 €1,249.95 winner; CSL Sprint 5787 non-Systemtreff challenger; broad cross-vendor scan
reports.summary: 跨商家扫描后今日总冠军为 SYSTEMTREFF Ed76：Ryzen 7 5700X/RTX 5060 Ti 8GB/16GB DDR4/1TB/Windows 11 Pro/B550 ATX/650W be quiet!，直售价€1,249.95+德国保险配送€9.90=€1,259.85。以同 SKU 7天均价€1,279.90（n=7）、30天均价€1,279.90（n=9）作市场参考，折扣2.34%，刷新本仓库跟踪低价；🟡普通好价，机会稀缺度3/10。主要短板是默认16GB，32GB配置到手€1,349.85，超主要预算。最佳非同商家挑战者为CSL Sprint 5787：€1,249+约€9.85运费，32GB/RTX5060Ti8GB，但A520、500W CSL Bronze、无OS/无Wi-Fi；到手价与总冠军只差约€1。相对HP Z2固定Reference（i7-12700K/32GB/UHD770），Ed76 CPU和RAM均退步，仅GPU和Win11 Pro远程主机能力明显提升；优先核对HP Z2 PSU/空间，考虑只升级GPU。
reports.trend_summary: SYSTEMTREFF Ed76: prior 7d mean €1,279.90 (n=7), prior 30d mean €1,279.90 (n=9), tracked low €1,279.90; today €1,249.95 is 2.34% below and a new tracked low, improving modestly. CSL Sprint5815 rose from €1,199 to direct €1,349 (+12.51%); CSL 5787 is €1,249 versus 7d mean €1,211.50 and tracked low €1,099; CSL 5548 is flat at €1,299. Overall: one local improvement, no broad market anomaly.

additional_candidates.notes: Direct new sale by IT-Systemtreff GmbH, not marketplace. 16GB DDR4-3200 dual-channel (2x8); 32GB generic option +€90, making €1,339.95 + €9.90 shipping = €1,349.85, above core budget. Kingston Fury 2x16 option +€134. Windows 11 Pro included. 1TB WD SN3000. Default has no Wi-Fi; use wired LAN. Exact GPU card/output model not named on Ed76 page. Standard ATX B550; AM4 is end-of-line. Trustpilot about 4.3/5 from 2,137 reviews; about 8% one-star and 80% negative reviews answered; generally positive but not risk-free.

Direct CSL sale. 32GB DDR4-3200 2x16, 1TB M.2 PCIe4 SSD (board's M.2 is PCIe3), RTX 5060 Ti 8GB with 1 HDMI + 3 DP. No OS and no Wi-Fi; Windows Pro license/setup extra for native RDP host. 500W CSL Bronze PSU and A520/one M.2/PCIe 3.0 make upgrades less attractive than winner. About €1 cheaper landed, with 32GB immediately, but loses Windows Pro, ATX B550, branded 650W PSU and 3-year/30-day service.

Official CSL page today shows €1,349, not the €1,199 still visible in an Idealo search snippet. 32GB/1TB, no OS/no Wi-Fi, 500W Bronze and A520 from prior full config capture. Use direct checkout price, not stale comparison snippet.

Same CPU tier as winner, but 16GB DDR4 single-channel (1x16), Radeon rather than NVIDIA CUDA/OptiX, 500W CSL PSU, A520, no OS/no Wi-Fi. 16GB VRAM may help large textures/viewports but does not replace CUDA for supported renderers.

Best sub-€1,310 AM5 upgrade platform: 4 DIMM, 2 M.2, 2.5GbE and Wi-Fi 6. 16GB DDR5 is 2x8 dual-channel; 700W Gold but BoostBoxx model not independently identified. No OS. Radeon 16GB has no CUDA/OptiX; landed price is €8.85 above core budget.

Direct new sale. Windows 11 Pro, 1TB WD SN3000, 650W be quiet!, 16GB DDR4 dual-channel, A520 board. Configurator 32GB +€90 and B550 Gaming X V2 +€43; combined product price €1,222.95, landed €1,232.85. Still Ryzen 5 5600 and RTX5060, not a CPU upgrade over HP Z2.

Not stock SKU: base Ed75 €1,089.95 + 32GB DDR4 option €90 + B550 Gaming X V2 ATX option €43. Landed €1,232.85. Windows 11 Pro and 650W be quiet! retained. Still Ryzen 5 5600 and RTX5060 8GB, so less GPU/CPU headroom than Ed76.

Direct NBB sale, but €1,249 is Campus-exclusive. Page lists 5700X, 32GB, RTX5060Ti, 1TB M.2, Wi-Fi and Windows 11 Pro. Board, PSU, DIMM/M.2/PCIe layout and case standard undisclosed; do not assume five-year upgradeability.
Campus-only NBB listing. 16GB, 1TB, RTX5060, Wi-Fi 6/BT5.4 and GbE. OEM chassis/board/PSU makes GPU/PSU/board upgrades less transparent.
Over core budget before shipping, only 16GB and no Windows Pro confirmed. Board/PSU details not transparent enough for five-year planning.
AM5/DDR5 but A620AM-K has only 2 DIMM and one M.2; 16GB only. Radeon 8GB lacks CUDA/OptiX. OS and Wi-Fi not confirmed.
Direct German retailer. Windows 11 Home, 16GB, 500GB SSD, RTX5060, H610. Windows Home is not a native RDP host; 16GB/500GB and lower GPU tier make it weaker than Ed76.

Actual seller IT-Systemtreff GmbH, platform Saturn Marketplace. 32GB/Win11Pro/USB Wi-Fi+BT but Ryzen5 5600, 450W PSU and 2-DIMM A520 are poor upgrade base. Do not assume Saturn direct-retail 30-day return applies.
Same actual seller as winner but via Saturn Marketplace. 32GB and Win11Pro; A520M-A PRO and 450W PSU are weaker than direct Ed76 B550 ATX/650W. €90 more for RAM while losing board/PSU headroom.
Current page says sold and shipped by SYSTEMTREFF. 32GB, Windows 11 Pro, USB Wi-Fi/BT, 1GbE; 450W PSU and MSI A520M-A PRO. More expensive than direct Ed76 despite weaker CPU, board and PSU.
Technically attractive 16GB NVIDIA VRAM, 32GB DDR4, ATX B550 and 650W AZZA Bronze, but €1,749 exceeds both budget bands; no OS and no Wi-Fi.

additional_candidates.seller: MYPC (legal entity not confirmed; Saturn Marketplace)
additional_candidates.notes: Actual platform Saturn Marketplace, seller shown as MYPC; legal entity and exact GPU/board/PSU not confirmed. Do not purchase without full BOM and warranty seller identity.
Marketplace seller NEXOC STORE DE, not MediaMarkt itself. 32GB/1TB/5700X, FreeDOS; board and PSU details limited. Above core budget and no Windows Pro.

AM5, 32GB DDR5 2x16, RX9060XT16, 700W Gold and Wi-Fi6/2.5GbE. No OS and Radeon lacks CUDA/OptiX. €1,588.85 landed is within upper cap but not exceptional for a 6-core CPU and no NVIDIA engineering stack.
AM5 and 16GB NVIDIA VRAM are attractive, but only 16GB DDR5, 500W CSL Bronze PSU, no OS and landed price exceeds €1,600. RAM and PSU upgrades worsen total cost.

reports.title: 2026-11-16 Desktop Angebot Search — CSL Sprint5815 €1,199 champion; SYSTEMTREFF Ed76 non-CSL challenger; x-kom price-close comparison
reports.summary: Broad cross-vendor scan with 18 current candidate observations. General-access champion CSL Sprint5815 direct €1,199 + €9.85 Germany DHL = €1,208.85 landed (5700X/RTX5060Ti8/32GB/1TB, ASUS A520M-A II/CSM mATX, 500W CSL Bronze, no OS); ordinary good price, peer-market reference €1,260, 4.84% list discount / 4.06% landed. Exact SKU history flat at €1,199 in 7d/30d/tracked low, but only 3 observations across 2 dates. Best non-CSL functional challenger SYSTEMTREFF Ed76 €1,279.90 + shipping (5700X/Ti8/16GB/WD1TB/B550 ATX/650W be quiet!/WinPro, 3y/30d direct terms); costs €80.90 more before shipping and trades 16GB initial RAM for better ATX/PSU/RDP. Closest price comparison x-kom M3A WinHome €1,289.99, but H610 2-DIMM/64GB and current price +11.30% vs tracked low.
